future_trace_schema.seed: required harness-owned seed; may be held-out
future_trace_schema.context_id: required harness-owned context id; may be held-out
future_trace_schema.heldout_status: required enum: train, heldout_context, unseen_seed, unseen_combination, harness_counterfactual
future_trace_schema.boundary_condition_public_proxy: optional candidate-visible proxy; never hidden truth
future_trace_schema.action_source: required enum: candidate_selected, fixed_action_set, harness_sampled_probe, harness_counterfactual
future_trace_schema.prediction: required raw candidate prediction; not expected label or answer key
future_trace_schema.serialized_candidate_state: required replay input; forbidden to contain direct input-output answer tables for replay targets
future_trace_schema.harness_owned_target_id: required target id owned by harness/environment
future_trace_schema.baseline_invocation: required object naming independent baseline callable and input ids
future_trace_schema.replay_recomputation_input: required object containing serialized candidate state plus held-out/unseen observation or harness-owned counterfactual transition
future_trace_schema.lookup_table_leakage_scan_result: required object for replay lookup-table positive control
